item.title: Geraldton Health Campus redevelopment exterior works complete as site works on oncology unit kick-off
item.description: The long overdue $190 million redevelopment of Geraldton Health Campus is getting closer to the finish line and has reached a major milestone, with outside works finished and the inside ready for fit-out.

item.title: AFL Origin: From Chris Mainwaring to Patrick Cripps, the torch of captaining WA has passed
item.description: The last time WA beat Victoria — almost 35 years ago — the black and gold was skippered by a Mid West player. Perhaps it’s a good omen come Saturday WA will again be led by a local product.

item.title: Geraldton Regional Art Gallery launches two new exhibitions celebrating the mediums of textiles and ceramics
item.description: More than 100 people gathered at Geraldton Regional Art Gallery last Friday night to celebrate the launch of two new stunning exhibitions showcasing the use of textiles and ceramics.

item.title: Local Geraldton businesses step up for Valentine’s Day, with plenty of options for couples and singles
item.description: Love is in the air this weekend in Geraldton, as couples get ready to celebrate Valentine’s Day on Saturday with local businesses primed to help make it happen.

item.title: Geraldton travellers still unsure what flights will see a price hike in the second half of the year
item.description: Capped prices on “high demand” flights will rise from July, but confusion remains over exactly when the travelling public will be faced with those higher fares.

item.title: CBH Group brings in record amount of grain from Geraldton zone in biggest harvest in its history
item.description: Geraldton grain farmers have seen their largest harvest on record, thanks to storage preparation and lucky weather conditions.

item.title: Pom in Oz with Derek Goforth: Valentine’s Day will pass, but real love is worth all the ups and downs
item.description: Valentine’s Day has a funny way of shrinking love down to its most marketable form. None of it is bad, but none of it is the point. Real love does not look much like the ads.

item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: Battle of the Beckhams is fodder for the masses, but why are we so interested?
item.description: There has been a lot going on in the world lately. Trump, Bondi, the former Prince Andrew. But it all seems to have been superseded by the battle of the Beckhams.

item.title: Durack MHR Melissa Price unsuccessful in deputy bid, but pledges ‘unwavering support’ for party’s new leaders
item.description: Durack MHR Melissa Price has pledged her “unwavering support” behind the new Liberal leadership team of Angus Taylor and Jane Hume despite supporting ousted leader Sussan Ley.

item.title: WA demersal fishing ban: Shark fisher John Higham stages rooftop protest against bans at fisheries office
item.description: A Geraldton fisher has chained himself to the roof of the local fisheries office and swallowed the key in protest against the State Government’s demersal fishing bans.
